results.detail: Re-derived from Update Heir main.cs:162 (DTSX:9612). The condition is gencountry_IsNull != Gencountrydb_IsNull || (gencity_IsNull == false && IsNeedToUpdate<String>(gencountry, Gencountrydb)). All three cases in the text follow from it. (a) City NULL and both country values present: both operands are false, so gen_country is not set. (b) Exactly one country value NULL: the first operand is true whatever the city is. (c) City present and both country values NULL: IsNeedToUpdate reads Row.gencountry and Row.Gencountrydb while both are NULL. The outcome of that read is correctly left unverified and marked as SSIS behaviour. The db side 'empty' equals NULL through 'change empty strings to null' (DTSX:4044: TRIM == "" ? NULL(DT_WSTR,50)). The file side 'empty' equals IsNull through the trim script (Trim All Input Columns 1 main.cs:53-57), with the caveat stated in the detailed claim. The finding is conditional and is not framed as a bug.
